question: Which countries have the highest PM2.5 exposure, and how has it changed since 1990?
summary: In 2023, the highest PM2.5 exposure was in Qatar (108 µg/m³), Saudi Arabia (74 µg/m³), Bangladesh (69 µg/m³), several times the WHO guideline of 5 µg/m³. Since 1990, 4 of these 15 countries improved while 11 worsened, so high exposure is persistent and not uniformly improving.
